ATOM: At the β2-adrenoceptor, compounds displaying β-arrestin-biased signalling have a greater effect on the conformation of TM7.
KEY POINTS:
1. TM7 (transmembrane helix 7)

ANSWER TO GRADE:
**Transmembrane helix 7 (TM7)** is the one most strongly reshaped by β-arrestin-biased ligands at the β2-adrenoceptor. This is my best recollection of the structural literature rather than a checked citation, so treat it with some caution.
